CustomField.description: This Financial Year Auto calculated from created date of the PRF
CustomField.formula: TEXT( CASE( MONTH(DATEVALUE(CreatedDate)), 1, YEAR(DATEVALUE(CreatedDate)) - 1, 2, YEAR(DATEVALUE(CreatedDate)) - 1, 3, YEAR(DATEVALUE(CreatedDate)) - 1, YEAR(DATEVALUE(CreatedDate)) ) ) & "-" & TEXT( MOD( CASE( MONTH(DATEVALUE(CreatedDate)), 1, YEAR(DATEVALUE(CreatedDate)), 2, YEAR(DATEVALUE(CreatedDate)), 3, YEAR(DATEVALUE(CreatedDate)), YEAR(DATEVALUE(CreatedDate)) + 1 ), 100 ) )
CustomField.label: Financial Year
